meta.title: Unit 1 Final: Report, Presentation, and Defense

modules.intro: No points of its own. This is what you present from and what the 25 points are scored against. The assignment will not submit without it.
modules.title: Engineering Report
modules.aiNote: AI can draft and tighten the writing. Every number, property, and part number is checked against the catalog page or datasheet it came from.

blocks.content:
Four sections. Summarise; do not paste your checkpoint work in whole.

Sources: IDEA209H syllabus v4; approved IDEA209 course description, Unit 1.

blocks.prompt: Design summary. The scenario in your own words, then your five governing results: holding torque, reduction, which requirement governed it, shaft load, load per bolt with its factor of safety. Name the method behind each. No arithmetic.
Selection justification. Each component on your BOM in turn: the published property you selected against, its value, and the source. "Appropriate" or "sufficient" is not a justification.
BOM status. What changed after Checkpoint 2 and why. Confirm every line has a vendor, part number, and quantity. Name any line that does not.
Trade-offs. One candidate you rejected, the trade-off it lost on, and what would have to change for it to win.

modules.intro: Scored live in your slot. Nothing is submitted here.
modules.title: Presentation and Defense

blocks.content:
Six minutes: set up, present, defend. Present from your report and keep it open in front of you. Questions come from the class and the instructor.

What the three criteria read:

| Criterion | Max | Read against |
|---|---|---|
| Selection rationale | 8 | Section 2 |
| Defends every value | 10 | Section 1 |
| Responds to questions | 7 | Whatever is asked |

Saying you do not know a value and naming where you would look it up counts as an answer. Inventing one does not.

A number or decision you cannot defend comes back as a comment on this assignment in IDEA Classroom, due end of the same day. That section's share of the 25 points is held until it is in.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Presents every component on the bill of materials, naming for each the published property or rating it was selected against and that property's value.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Presents every component but leaves the governing property unnamed on one, or names properties throughout while omitting one component.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Presents at least half the components, with the governing property named on fewer than half of those presented.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Presents fewer than half the components, or does not present.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: For each of the five governing results, states the method and the inputs it was run on when asked, and the stated value matches the report.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Defends four of the five with method and inputs; one is restated without a method, or its value disagrees with the report.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Defends two or three of the five with method and inputs; the rest are asserted or read off with no method stated.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Defends fewer than two of the five, or does not present.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Answers every question with information not already in the presented section, or states the answer is not known and names where it would be looked up.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Answers all but one question with new information; one repeats what the report already said without adding to it.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Half or more of the answers repeat the report without adding information, while at least one adds something new.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No question is answered beyond a restatement, or no questions are taken.
